mapper.select:
select * from (select rownum rn,m.* from (select 'IN' as io_type, i.inbound_id as io_id, i.webuser_id, i.request_date, i.approval_status from inbound i where i.approval_status='REQUEST'
union all
select 'OUT' as io_type, o.outbound_id as io_id, o.webuser_id, o.request_date, o.approval_status from outbound o where o.approval_status='REQUEST'
order by request_date desc) m) where rn >=#{startRow} and rn <=#{endRow}

select NVL(count(*),0) from (select 'in' as io_type, i.inbound_id as io_id, i.webuser_id, i.request_date, i.approval_status from inbound i where i.approval_status = 'REQUEST'
union all
select 'out' as io_type, o.outbound_id as io_id, o.webuser_id, o.request_date, o.approval_status from outbound o where o.approval_status = 'REQUEST'
order by request_date desc)

select * from (select rownum rn,m.* from ( select 'in' as io_type, i.inbound_id as io_id, i.webuser_id, i.request_date, i.approval_status from inbound i
union all
select 'out' as io_type, o.outbound_id as io_id, o.webuser_id, o.request_date, o.approval_status from outbound o
order by request_date desc )m where webuser_id=#{webuser_id}) where rn>=#{startRow} and rn<=#{endRow}

select NVL(count(*),0) from (select rownum rn,m.* from ( select 'in' as io_type, i.inbound_id as io_id, i.webuser_id, i.request_date, i.approval_status from inbound i
union all
select 'out' as io_type, o.outbound_id as io_id, o.webuser_id, o.request_date, o.approval_status from outbound o
order by request_date desc )m where webuser_id=#{webuser_id})

select * from ( select rownum rn,m.* from ( select i.inbound_id as inbound_id, min(p.product_name) || case when count(*)>1 then ' 외 ' || (count(*)-1) || '개' else '' end as product_name, w.webuser_name as webuser_name, i.approval_status as approval_status, i.is_refund as is_refund, i.request_date as request_date from inbound i join inbound_detail d on i.inbound_id=d.inbound_id join webuser w on i.webuser_id=w.webuser_id join product p on d.product_id=p.product_id where i.approval_status='REQUEST' group by i.inbound_id,w.webuser_name,i.approval_status, i.is_refund,i.request_date order by i.inbound_id desc ) m ) t where t.rn>=#{startRow} and t.rn<=#{endRow}

select count(*) from ( select i.inbound_id from inbound i join inbound_detail d on i.inbound_id=d.inbound_id join product p on d.product_id=p.product_id where i.approval_status='REQUEST' group by i.inbound_id )
select NVL(count(*),0) from inbound where webuser_id=#{webuser_id}

select * from (select rownum rn,m.* from (select o.outbound_id as outbound_id, min(p.product_name) || case when count(*)>1 then ' 외 ' || (count(*)-1) || '개' else '' end as product_name, w.webuser_name as webuser_name, o.approval_status as approval_status, o.request_date as request_date from outbound o join outbound_detail d on o.outbound_id=d.outbound_id join webuser w on o.webuser_id=w.webuser_id join product p on d.product_id=p.product_id where o.approval_status='REQUEST' group by o.outbound_id,w.webuser_name,o.approval_status, o.request_date order by o.outbound_id desc)m) where rn>=#{startRow} and rn<=#{endRow}

select count(*) from ( select o.outbound_id from outbound o join outbound_detail d on o.outbound_id=d.outbound_id join product p on d.product_id=p.product_id where o.approval_status='REQUEST' group by o.outbound_id )
select NVL(count(*),0) from outbound
select * from inbound_detail where inbound_id=#{value}

select d.inbound_detail_id as inbound_detail_id, d.inbound_id as inbound_id, p.product_name as product_name, i.save_name as save_name, d.quantity as quantity, w.warehouse_name as warehouse_name, d.approval_status as approval_status from inbound_detail d join warehouse w on d.warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id join product p on d.product_id = p.product_id join product_image i on p.image_id = i.image_id where d.inbound_id= #{inboundId} order by d.inbound_detail_id desc
select * from outbound_detail where outbound_id=#{value}

select d.outbound_detail_id as outbound_detail_id, d.outbound_id as outbound_id, p.product_name as product_name, i.save_name as save_name, d.quantity as quantity, d.approval_status as approval_status from outbound_detail d join product p on d.product_id = p.product_id join product_image i on p.image_id = i.image_id where d.outbound_id=#{outboundId} order by d.outbound_detail_id desc
select * from inbound_detail where inbound_detail_id=#{value}
select * from outbound_detail where outbound_detail_id=#{value}
select count(*) from approval
select count(*) from approval where bound_type = #{boundType}

select * from (select rownum rn, w.* from (select a.approval_id as approval_id, w.webuser_name as approver_name, i.inbound_id as inbound_id, min(p.product_name) || case when count(*)>1 then ' 외 ' || (count(*)-1) || '개' else '' end as product_name, a.approval_status as approval_status, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.is_refund = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS is_refund, a.created_at as created_at from approval a join webuser w on a.approver_id=w.webuser_id join inbound i on a.inbound_id=i.inbound_id join inbound_detail d on i.inbound_id=d.inbound_id join product p on d.product_id=p.product_id where a.bound_type='IN' and a.approval_status='APPROVED' group by a.approval_id, w.webuser_name, i.inbound_id, a.approval_status, a.created_at having sum( case when d.approval_status = 'APPROVED' and d.inbound_status = 'REQUEST' then 1 else 0 end ) > 0 order by a.created_at desc)w) where rn >= #{startRow} and rn <= #{endRow}

select * from ( select rownum rn, w.* from ( select a.approval_id, w.webuser_name as approver_name, o.outbound_id, min(p.product_name) || case when count(distinct d.product_id) > 1 then ' 외 ' || (count(distinct d.product_id) - 1) || '개' else '' end as product_name, a.approval_status, a.created_at, case when sum(case when l.is_expired = 'Y' then 1 else 0 end) > 0 then 'Y' else 'N' end as is_expired from approval a join webuser w on a.approver_id = w.webuser_id join outbound o on a.outbound_id = o.outbound_id join outbound_detail d on o.outbound_id = d.outbound_id join product p on d.product_id = p.product_id left join lot_out l on l.outbound_detail_id = d.outbound_detail_id where a.bound_type = 'OUT' and d.approval_status = 'APPROVED' group by a.approval_id, w.webuser_name, o.outbound_id, a.approval_status, a.created_at having sum( case when d.outbound_status = 'REQUEST' then 1 else 0 end ) > 0 order by a.created_at desc ) w ) where rn >= #{startRow} and rn <= #{endRow}

select count(approval_id) from (select a.approval_id as approval_id, w.webuser_name as approver_name, i.inbound_id as inbound_id, min(p.product_name) || case when count(*)>1 then ' 외 ' || (count(*)-1) || '개' else '' end as product_name, a.approval_status as approval_status, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.is_refund = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS is_refund, a.created_at as created_at from approval a join webuser w on a.approver_id=w.webuser_id join inbound i on a.inbound_id=i.inbound_id join inbound_detail d on i.inbound_id=d.inbound_id join product p on d.product_id=p.product_id where a.bound_type='IN' and a.approval_status='APPROVED' group by a.approval_id, w.webuser_name, i.inbound_id, a.approval_status, a.created_at having sum( case when d.inbound_status = 'REQUEST' then 1 else 0 end ) > 0 order by a.created_at desc)w

select count(approval_id) from ( select a.approval_id, w.webuser_name as approver_name, o.outbound_id, min(p.product_name) || case when count(distinct d.product_id) > 1 then ' 외 ' || (count(distinct d.product_id) - 1) || '개' else '' end as product_name, a.approval_status, a.created_at, case when sum(case when l.is_expired = 'Y' then 1 else 0 end) > 0 then 'Y' else 'N' end as is_expired from approval a join webuser w on a.approver_id = w.webuser_id join outbound o on a.outbound_id = o.outbound_id join outbound_detail d on o.outbound_id = d.outbound_id join product p on d.product_id = p.product_id join lot_out l on l.outbound_detail_id = d.outbound_detail_id where a.bound_type = 'OUT' and d.approval_status = 'APPROVED' group by a.approval_id, w.webuser_name, o.outbound_id, a.approval_status, a.created_at having sum( case when d.outbound_status = 'REQUEST' then 1 else 0 end ) > 0 order by a.created_at desc ) w
select * from inbound_detail where inbound_id=#{value} and approval_status='APPROVED'
select * from outbound_detail where outbound_id=#{value} and approval_status='APPROVED'

select i.webuser_id, d.inbound_detail_id, p.product_name, w.warehouse_name, d.approval_status, d.inbound_status, d.reason, d.quantity from inbound_detail d join product p on d.product_id=p.product_id join warehouse w on d.warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id join inbound i on i.inbound_id=d.inbound_id where d.inbound_id=#{value}

select o.webuser_id, d.outbound_detail_id, p.product_name, d.approval_status, d.outbound_status, d.reason, d.quantity from outbound_detail d join product p on d.product_id=p.product_id join outbound o on o.outbound_id=d.outbound_id where d.outbound_id=#{value}
